# Marks of other organisations

These files are used unchanged in the destination capsules of the README and the Hugging Face pages, each beside a link to its own service. The Hugging Face and arXiv marks are also copied unchanged to `docs/site/home/brand/`, beside the homepage's Models and Paper links. They are the property of their owners; no endorsement is implied.

| File | Source | Terms |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `huggingface-logo.svg` | `hf-logo.svg` from the Hugging Face brand assets, <https://huggingface.co/brand> (<https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/brand-assets>) | Published by Hugging Face "to use in your projects"; Hugging Face's trademark |
| `arxiv-logomark-small.svg` | The small arXiv logomark (`arxiv-logomark-small-svg`) from arXiv's brand assets, <https://info.arxiv.org/brand/brand-guidelines.html#download-arxiv-logo-assets> (<https://cornell.box.com/v/arxiv-logomark-small-svg>) | arXiv's registered trademark |
| `octicons-book-16.svg`, `octicons-issue-opened-16.svg`, `octicons-git-pull-request-16.svg`, `octicons-mark-github-16.svg` | GitHub Octicons, <https://github.com/primer/octicons> (`icons/`) | MIT licence, `octicons-LICENSE.txt`; drawn in the capsule's colour, as Octicons are meant to be; the GitHub mark is GitHub's trademark |
